title: X-Men: Children of the Atom
overview:
It's here! Ultimate combat! X-Power! Special Moves! Mid-air action! Huge characters! Sizzling graphics! Exactly like you played it in the arcade! You will need all your mutant powers, all your speed, all your strength...for here is the ultimate combat! X-Men: Children of the Atom - the fighting game to end them all!

Magneto plans to unleash an electromagnetic pulse that will plunge the human world into a dark age, and the X-Men's deadliest foes have joined his cause. Pick a hero such as Wolverine, Cyclops, Storm, Iceman, Colossus or Psylocke, or a villain such as Omega Red, Sentinel, Silver Samurai or Spiral, and fight one-on-one through to Juggernaut and Magneto.

- Build the X-Power gauge to unleash mutant powers and devastating Hyper-X attacks
- Super jumps, mid-air attacks and long multi-hit combos
- Arcade, Versus, Survival and Group Battle modes
- Multi-level stages where fighters can crash through to the floor below
